1 قَلِتَ , aor.
قَلَتَ , inf. n. قَلَتٌ, (S, * Mgh, O, * Msb, K,) He, or it, perished, or died. (S, Mgh, O, Msb, K.) One says, مَا ٱنْفَلَتُوا وَلٰكِنْ قُلِتُوا [They did not escape, but they perished, or died]. (S, O. [Golius and Freytag appear to have read انقلتوا; for they have said, as on the authority of J, that the seventh form of the verb is not to be used for the first form.])
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
